test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A political party can be recognised as a national party if it secures ___ of the valid votes in any four states in general or state assembly elections and in addition it wins 4 Lok Sabha seat from any state or states.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 6%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A political party can be recognized as a national party in India if it secures at least **6%** of the valid votes in** any four states during general or state assembly elections.**
 
• In addition to the vote percentage, the party must win **4 Lok Sabha seats** from any state or states.
 
• This recognition allows the party to avail certain benefits, including the allocation of a common symbol and access to public funding for elections.
 
• The criteria for national party recognition are outlined by the **Election Commission of India**, ensuring a fair and transparent electoral process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Political Party Types**: In India, parties can be classified as national parties, state parties, or registered unrecognized parties based on their electoral performance and organizational structure.
 
• **State Party Recognition**: For a party to be recognized as a state party, it must secure at least **6%** of the valid votes in a state assembly election or win **2 Lok Sabha seats **
 
• **Impact of Recognition**: Recognition as a national or state party enhances a party's credibility and can significantly affect its ability to mobilize resources and attract voters.
 
• **Current National Parties**: Some of the recognized national parties in India include the Indian National Congress (INC), Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), and the Communist Party of India (CPI).
